name: Beef hoof and tendon porridge
summary: Porridge of beef hoof and tendon with mung beans, peanuts, white beans, and cassava, finished with rau má and leafy greens.
origin: Củ Chi. Báo Quốc tế, on 11 Aug 2024, describes cháo dựng bò.
howToEat: Cook beef hoof and tendon with mung beans, peanuts, white beans, khoai, and cassava, then add rau má, mồng tơi, and cải.
seoTitle: Beef hoof porridge in Cu Chi
seoDescription: Porridge of beef hoof and tendon with beans, cassava, and leafy greens.
